note: reactbits.dev — animated React components. The registry merges each component's four stack builds (AnimatedContent-JS-CSS … -TS-TW) into one item whose id is the slugged PascalCase name (reactbits-dev/animatedcontent); the site's pages are kebab-case (/animations/animated-content, /text-animations/split-text, /backgrounds/…, /components/…). loose_ids compares letters and digits only, so each page fills its component's url; attach_only keeps the pages from making items. /micro/* (34 micro-interaction pages) has no registry twin and stays out, as do /get-started/*, /pro, /showcase, /sponsors, /favorites. Replaces the template skip in catalog/registry-urls/reactbits.dev.json (coordinator, 2026-10-10).
